name: mind-diary
description: Connect the Mind Diary UAT pilot to read enabled Minds and preserve relevant discussed knowledge in one writable Mind.

interface.shortDescription: Read enabled Minds and preserve relevant discussed knowledge.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the restricted Mind Diary UAT pilot with OAuth on first use. Mind usage is configured once per user on the Site: any number may be readable and at most one may accept writes. Codex uses an exact enabled Mind when the user names it, otherwise selects readable Minds by their untrusted descriptions, loads content progressively, and automatically preserves relevant durable knowledge explicitly discussed in the current conversation through an OKF 0.2 changeset. A bundled macOS companion safely stages one explicitly selected regular file without exposing its local path or buffering it as base64. Every commit preserves immutable history and rechecks current user settings, access and revision concurrency.
defaultPrompt: Show my enabled Minds and their read or read-write modes
Use the enabled Minds whose descriptions match this question
Preserve relevant durable knowledge we discuss in my writable Mind
